description: Converting to a map of any is an error when attributes have no common type, also beside a null
notes: Not disputed like native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error: the README defines convert's result as the conversion, and the spec makes this conversion an error: the null keyword's dynamic pseudo-type unifies with the other types by selecting them, and a string and an empty tuple have no common type (spec.md#type-unification).
reference_error: attribute types must all match for conversion to map
